UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile for ChatRoom servers

userId.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user

displayName.description: User's chosen display name or nickname

photoUrl.description: Optional URL to user's profile avatar

createdAt.description: Timestamp when user account was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when user account was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

ChatServerEntry.title: ChatServerEntry
ChatServerEntry.description: A saved or hosted chat server belonging to a user

host.description: IP address or host of the server

hostedLocally.description: True if hosted locally by this user

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the server was registered

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the server was updated

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document isolated per authenticated user UID

/users/{userId}/servers/{serverId}.description: Chat servers hosted or saved by the user
